items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: No, he wasn't in the Army with me. If he was, I didn't know him then.

ctx.x: Did you ever know Hank Benson? Sure, Hank Benson, trombone player. He worked with you, that's right. Yeah. It wasn't him on trombone in the Army though, huh?
No, he wasn't in the Army with me. If he was, I didn't know him then.
It was another Ben that played trombone then.
